flow_ref: ACM_FSD _v1.2.pdf sec. 1.3 (p.8-9, wins); ACM_Functional_Document_v1.0.pdf sec. 11 User Registration (p.14); HCL_CAC.pptx (high-level images only, not module-specific; later decks unknown)
code_summary: Web (React): spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Containers/ACM/ManageUser/UserList.js, spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Components/DataTable.js, spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Components/ConfirmModal.js, spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Sagas/ManageUser/*, spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Components/ExportToExcel.js. API (iz): spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/controller/UserController.java -> spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/service/UserService.java -> UserRepository -> table ACM_USER; UIAM list via spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/controller/UIAMInterfaceController.java -> spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/service/UIAMInterfaceService.java -> view v_uiam2_all_staff. Not in the external API (spms_common_ez_api_app-main was not traced for user CRUD).
note: Compared with ACM_FSD _v1.2.pdf sec. 1.3 (wins if decks disagree). Results were checked against the code; the content of the UIAM view, the ACM_USER data, and the modal display in a browser cannot be verified from the repo. AAD login (the first FSD step) was not traced here. HCL_CAC.pptx is high-level images only and is not used as step evidence.
recommendation: Partial claim: the ACTIVE list, Add User from UIAM, add without approval, mobile-only edit and delete confirmation work. Fix before a full claim: AC-ADMIN check on the API, per-column sort, Name search on the Remove/Edit tab, .xlsx export, the default ADMIN user type, delete being a soft delete, and specific error messages.

steps.step: Only Staff with the AC-ADMIN role can access Manage User
steps.detail: The restriction exists only in the UI: the Manage User menu (optionValue 'MU') has accessRole 'AC-admin' (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Utility/constant.js:14) and is shown only if the user's role in the ACM application matches (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Components/LayoutACM.js:51). The route /acm/manage-user (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Navigation/RoutesConfig.js:164) uses PrivateRouteACMConfig, which only checks that the user has an ACM application (not verified per role in this code; same as ACM1.2). On the API, spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/controller/UserController.java:23-93 has no role check, spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/security/WebSecurityConfig.java:124 and :167 open requests with permitAll(), and spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/security/jwt/ACMAuthTokenFilter.java:42-51 only protects 8 allowlisted paths (not /acm/v1/user/**). So createUser/updateUser/deleteUser have no server-side AC-ADMIN check. AAD login is not examined in this story.

steps.step: Staff selects Manage User and sees the list of ACTIVE users (URAMS ID, Name, Department, Designation, Email, Mobile)
steps.detail: The 'Remove / Edit User' tab calls getAcmUser with an empty userId (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Containers/ACM/ManageUser/UserList.js:42); the saga picks the viewAllUsers endpoint (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Sagas/ManageUser/AcmUserSaga.js:16-24) -> spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/controller/UserController.java:51-55 -> spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/service/UserService.java:123-131, which calls findByStatusOrderByUserIdAsc(ACTIVE), so only ACTIVE users, ordered by URAMS ID. Table columns: URAMS ID, Name, Department, Designation, Email, Mobile (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Utility/constant.js:103-111, rows in spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Components/DataTable.js:418-440). Actual data in the DB cannot be verified from the repo.

steps.step: Staff can search by URAMS ID and Name
steps.detail: The search box on the Remove/Edit tab is labeled only 'URAMS ID' (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Containers/ACM/ManageUser/UserList.js:95). The entered text is sent as userId to viewByUser (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Sagas/ManageUser/AcmUserSaga.js:16-19) -> spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/controller/UserController.java:45-49 -> spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/service/UserService.java:114-121, which looks up the exact userId (findByUserIdAndStatusIn ACTIVE). Name search does not work on this tab, and when nothing is found NotExistsException is returned as HTTP 200 with a text body (spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/exception/CustomControllerAdvice.java:27-30), not an empty list. A 'contains' search exists in the API (spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/service/UserService.java:231-243, includes INACTIVE users because it does not filter status) but this web search path does not use it. Search on the Add User (UIAM) tab supports Name and URAMS ID, see step 6.

steps.step: Staff can sort the URAMS ID and Name columns
steps.detail: The table header only renders column text with no click/sort handler (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Components/DataTable.js:259-274); spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Containers/ACM/ManageUser/UserList.js has no sort state or parameter. The only ordering is ORDER BY userId ASC from the API (spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/service/UserService.java:124), which the user cannot change. Same as sibling stories (no user-driven sort).

steps.step: Staff can export all searched/filtered data to Excel
steps.detail: An 'Export to Excel' button exists (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Containers/ACM/ManageUser/UserList.js:115, spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Components/ExportToExcel.js:8-15) and exports the whole props.userData (not only the current page), so search results are included. But the format is CSV ('Users.csv', react-csv library), not an .xlsx Excel file. The button also appears on the Add User tab, where it exports the UIAM list, not ACM users.

steps.step: Staff opens 'Add Users' and the system loads user data from UIAM, searchable by Name or URAMS ID
steps.detail: The 'Add User' tab calls getUiamsUser (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Containers/ACM/ManageUser/UserList.js:43) -> spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Services/ServiceConfig.js:41 -> spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/controller/UIAMInterfaceController.java:27-31 -> spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/service/UIAMInterfaceService.java:46-56, which reads the view v_uiam2_all_staff (spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/entities/Uiam2AllStaffView.java:17), ordered by userId. Search is done on the web side: spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Sagas/ManageUser/UserSearchSaga.js:27-34 filters userId or fullName (contains, case-insensitive); placeholder 'Name, URAMS ID (New User)' (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Containers/ACM/ManageUser/UserList.js:95). The add button is disabled when delInd is not 'A' (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Components/DataTable.js:458), so staff who are inactive in UIAM cannot be added. The content of the UIAM view cannot be verified from the repo.

steps.step: Staff clicks the add button and picks a user type (admin, approver, supporter, user), including new administrators
steps.detail: Clicking the plus icon (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Components/DataTable.js:210-215) opens a confirmation modal with a 'User Type' dropdown (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Components/ConfirmModal.js:160-173). Options come from the API viewAllUserType (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Components/ConfirmModal.js:130, spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/controller/UserController.java:87-91), which reads ADMIN, APPROVER, SUPPORTER, USER from spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/resources/application.yml:122-127, so new administrators can be created. But the value sent comes from the Redux state selectedUserRole with default 'ADMIN' (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Reducers/ManageUser/index.js:9), which only changes on the dropdown onChange (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Components/ConfirmModal.js:145-147) and is never reset. The dropdown is not bound to state (uncontrolled, ConfirmModal.js:166); after the component is re-mounted (for example after Edit or Delete) it shows the first option again while the state still holds the old type; behaviour in the browser is not verified. Also, if staff presses Yes without choosing, the saved type is ADMIN (the most privileged type) while FD sec. 11.3 advises 'User' for a normal user.

steps.step: Staff confirms (Submit/Yes) and the backend adds the user to the SPMS DB with no approval
steps.detail: Yes calls postUser (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Containers/ACM/ManageUser/UserList.js:65-79; userType from state, status 'ACTIVE', phoneNumber sent empty) -> spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Sagas/ManageUser/AddUserSaga.js:22-30 -> spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/controller/UserController.java:31-36 (201 Created) -> spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/service/UserService.java:85-99, which saves a new row in ACM_USER (spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/entities/User.java:18). If the user is already ACTIVE, ACMEntityAlreadyExistsException -> HTTP 400 (spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/exception/CustomControllerAdvice.java:32-35); if INACTIVE, the user is reactivated with the new type. There is no approval step. After success the list reloads and the tab switches to Remove/Edit (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Sagas/ManageUser/AddUserSaga.js:32-43). The initial mobile number is always empty and must be set through edit.

steps.step: Staff clicks edit and only the mobile number can be changed
steps.detail: The edit icon (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Components/DataTable.js:202-208) opens an 'Update Mobile' modal with a single phoneNumber field (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Components/ConfirmModal.js:59-96, Yup validation in spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Containers/ACM/SechmaValidation.js:44-45). The updateUser request (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Sagas/ManageUser/UpdateUserSaga.js:21-29) -> spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/controller/UserController.java:38-43; the DTO spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/dto/UserUpdateRequest.java only holds userId and phoneNumber (Singapore number regex spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/constants/AcmConstants.java:31), and spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/service/UserService.java:101-112 only sets phoneNumber, updatedBy, updatedDate. So no other field can be changed, through the UI or the API. There is no approval.

steps.step: Staff clicks delete and the user is removed from the SPMS DB after modal confirmation
steps.detail: The delete icon (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Components/DataTable.js:173-176) opens a confirmation modal (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Components/ConfirmModal.js:98-110); after Yes, deleteUser (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Components/DataTable.js:191) -> spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Sagas/ManageUser/DeleteUserSaga.js:21-29 -> spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/controller/UserController.java:61-66 -> spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/service/UserService.java:133-149. The confirmation exists and works. But what happens is a soft delete: the user's status is set to INACTIVE (the row stays in ACM_USER, spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/service/UserService.java:138), while the user's role rows are deleted permanently (spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/service/UserService.java:142-143). BR-MU-003 says 'remove the user from SPMS DB'; the row is not actually removed. The list reloads without that user because only ACTIVE users are shown.

steps.step: If there is a problem retrieving or submitting data, Staff sees a modal pop-up with an appropriate error message
steps.detail: There is global error handling, not specific to Manage User: 404/500 responses set a flag (spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Services/axios.configuration.js:43-47) and 400 sets another (same lines), then spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Components/ContentLayout.js:11-15 shows generic text 'We are unable to display the requested page...' or 'unable to retrieve the record...'. Specific API messages (e.g. 'User already exists' from spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/service/UserService.java:89) are not shown. Also NotExistsException is returned as HTTP 200 (spms_common_iz_api_app-main/src/main/java/sg/gov/ura/manage/parking/acm/exception/CustomControllerAdvice.java:27-30), so failures such as updating/deleting a non-existent user do not trigger the error modal. The sagas only store the error in state (errorUser, spms_common_iz_web_app-main/src/Reducers/ManageUser/index.js:45-50) with no on-screen message. The modal display was not checked in a browser.
